name: Tsuya Shitsui
source:
Tsuya is one of the few women who has fought in war only using these fists.
More powerful than a minotaur and faster than a vampire, Tsuya will not hesitate to beat the protagonist at their first encounter.
[spoiler]Little by little Tsuya ends up falling completely in love with Toma and does absolutely everything possible for Toma to become her boyfriend.[/spoiler]
